title: The Telangana Minor Forest Produce (Regulation of Trade) Act, 1971.
full_text: The Telangana Minor Forest Produce (Regulation of Trade) Act, 1971. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19714 Act Number: 4 Enactment Date: 1971-01-14 Act Year: 1971 Short Title: The Telangana Minor Forest Produce (Regulation of Trade) Act, 1971. Long Title: An Act to make provision for regulating in the public interest the trade of certain, minor forest produce by creation of a State monopoly in such trade in the State of Telangana. Department: Department of Environment, Forests, Science and Technology Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent, commencement and application. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Constitution of units. Section 4. Appointment of agents. Section 5. Restriction on purchase or transport of minor forest produce. Section 6. Constitution of Advisory Committee. Section 7. Government to fix price in consultation with Committee. Section 8. Opening of depots and publication of price list etc., at depots. Section 9. Government, authorized officer or agent to purchase minor forest produce. Section 10. Registration. Section 11. Registration of manufacturers of finished goods using minor forest produce and exporters of minor forest produce. Section 12. Disposal of minor forest produce. Section 13. Delegation of powers. Section 14. Power of entry, search, seizure, etc., Section 15. Penalty. Section 16. Attempts and abetment. Section 17. Cognizance of offences. Section 18. Saving in respect of acts done in good faith. Section 19. Power to make rules. Section 20. Act I of 1967 not to apply to minor forest produce. Section 21. Power to remove difficulty. Section 22. Power to amend the Schedule. Section 23. Application of section 19 (3) to notifications under sections 21 and 22. Section 24. Repeal and saving.
